title: Drop Zone
description: Files land on the plate and climb a ring toward done, thumbnails riding along for the ones that have them. About one in five stalls out with a reason and waits on a retry, while a line underneath keeps an honest count of the queue.
intent: A real product flow with every state a file can be in — dragging, uploading, thumbnailed, failed, retried — matching Herb's preference for finished interface mechanics over abstract demos.
